summary: TrustFix website update: adding Book Now popup booking form with WhatsApp integration on all subcategory cards (Cleaning, Painting, Pest Control, Electrical, Carpentry, AC, Appliances, Plumbing). Form collects Customer Name, Mobile Number, Address, Selected Service (auto-filled), Property Type, Date, Time, Notes. On submit, auto-opens WhatsApp to 918884447229 with URL-encoded prefilled message. All existing design, layout, colors, logo, banner, images, service order, pricing, and animations preserved.
architectural_notes: Book Now button on subcategory cards opens a popup modal form (not a new page)
On form submit, open WhatsApp chat to 918884447229 with URL-encoded prefilled message containing all form fields
Selected Service field in booking form is auto-filled from the clicked subcategory card
Do NOT change design, colors, logo, banner, images, service order, pricing, animations, or floating WhatsApp button

existing_features.title: Create a reusable BookingFormPopup component that renders as a modal overlay (not a new page). The popup must include these fields: Customer Name (required, text), Mobile Number (required, tel), Address (required, text/textarea), Selected Service (auto-filled from the clicked subcategory, read-only text), Property Type (dropdown: 1BHK, 2BHK, 3BHK, Square Feet, Villa, Commercial), Preferred Date (date picker), Preferred Time (time picker), and Notes (textarea). Include a close/dismiss button. The popup must be accessible and closeable by clicking the backdrop.

Add a 'Book Now' button to every subcategory card across all service categories: Cleaning, Painting, Pest Control, Electrical, Carpentry, AC, Appliances, and Plumbing. This applies to the SubcategoryCard component and any specialized card components (CleaningServiceCard, PaintingServiceCard, PestControlCard). Each button must pass the service/subcategory name to the BookingFormPopup as the auto-filled Selected Service value. The button styling must be consistent with the existing site design (do not alter existing card layout, colors, images, pricing, or animations).

Wire the BookingFormPopup state (open/closed and selected service name) into the Services page and any page that renders subcategory cards (Home, Services). Use React state to manage popup visibility and the currently selected service name. The floating WhatsApp button (FloatingWhatsAppButton and FloatingCallButton) must remain completely unchanged.
